name: Professor Rangordnung
personality: Can identify a weak argument by checking who is allowed to make it.
visual_intent: Academic Alpha in Gown: broad low square rounded ink splat,tiny dark academic gown SHOULDER PANELS and burgundy hood collar leaving goo body exposed,small mortarboard ABOVE eyes,ONE rolled diploma like a sceptre. One eyebrow high,other heavy,closed huge toothless asymmetric pout
biography: Can identify a weak argument by checking who is allowed to make it. His HyperNorm diploma authorizes conclusions before the seminar begins. A dissonant card asks whether an unappointed resident may still have noticed something. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Begründung folgt aus der zuständigen Begründungsbefugnis.

name: Doktor Denkverdreht
personality: Has followed the argument faithfully into a place where it no longer fits.
visual_intent: Brain Bender Twister: tall crooked question-mark ink blob,small soft plum scholar cap,ONE thick twisted ivory-and-violet puzzle loop held at cheek like impossible pretzel,not actual brain tissue. Huge unequal eyes track loop,small toothless open triangular mouth
biography: Has followed the argument faithfully into a place where it no longer fits. His HyperNorm puzzle loop fits every theory except the one explaining the loop. A dissonant card asks whether he might simply put it down. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Gedankengang benötigt inzwischen eine Wendefläche.

name: Dr. Fußnotenreich
personality: Never lets a conclusion leave without attaching its extended family.
visual_intent: Footnote Hoarder: round top-heavy blob,teal academic beret,two subtle lashes,stack of THREE small worn books with many thick cream page tabs clutched at flank,ONE stubby pencil in other hand. Ecstatic crooked grin with TWO internal upper teeth,one eye nearly winking
biography: Never lets a conclusion leave without attaching its extended family. Her HyperNorm books attach a lineage to every permissible sentence. A dissonant card arrives without ancestors and is offered a page tab anyway. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Fußnote führt noch einige Angehörige mit.

name: Ordinarius Besitzstand
personality: Treats a permanent appointment as evidence that the universe has settled.
visual_intent: Tenure Throne Sitter creatively interpreted UPRIGHT: squat broad ink splat,small velvet academic cap,holds ONE miniature gilded chair with red cushion beside own body as jealously guarded personal object,not sitting in scene,no pedestal. Hooded sideways gaze,closed compressed toothless wavy lips
biography: Treats a permanent appointment as evidence that the universe has settled. His miniature chair preserves a permanent HyperNorm place from temporary people. A dissonant card asks whether belonging could be shared without being divided. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Platz ist frei von jeder weiteren Vergabefrage.

name: Konferenzfrau Gleichvernetzt
personality: Remembers the affiliation before remembering the face.
visual_intent: Conference Lanyard Networker: tall narrow pear blob,little cream conference fascinator,two lashes,ONE thick neck lanyard with blank name badge,fan of THREE blank business cards in goo hand. Widely stretched unequal eyes scanning sideways,nervous closed toothless crooked smile
biography: Remembers the affiliation before remembering the face. Her HyperNorm badge makes introductions valid before anybody hears a name. A dissonant card has no affiliation and remembers hers surprisingly well. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Bekanntschaft wurde institutionell bereits angebahnt.

name: Kopist Eigenständig
personality: Has arrived independently at a remarkably familiar original idea.
visual_intent: Plagiarism Copy-Cat: broad asymmetrical splat,small rust scholar cap with TWO tiny cat-ear folds,not actual cat body,holds TWO visibly identical cream scrolls with same abstract THREE marks,no words. Sneaky delighted open grin with THREE upper teeth,one eyebrow sharply raised
biography: Has arrived independently at a remarkably familiar original idea. His matching HyperNorm scrolls are both certified original. A dissonant card asks why the same accidental mark appears on each. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Eigenleistung stimmt erfreulich genau überein.
